Visitor skips all input elements

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

type testVisitorVisitorInputSkip struct {
	htmd.BaseVisitor
}

func (v *testVisitorVisitorInputSkip) VisitInput(ctx htmd.NodeContext, inputType string, name *string, value *string) htmd.VisitResult {
	return htmd.VisitResultSkip()
}

func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{}
	visitor := &testVisitorVisitorInputSkip{}
	options.Visitor = visitor
	result, err := htmd.Convert(`<p>Sign up:</p><input type="text" name="email" placeholder="your@email.com"><input type="checkbox" name="agree"><p>Continue</p>`, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result)
}
```
